<subject>Maple & Crown Telecom Inc. for Years 2024/2025</subject>
<body>
Since Shirley and I are planning to be at Calgary tomorrow, we are providing you our laundry list of year end ROC (Return on Connectivity) items for discussion at your meeting tomorrow.

FYI, if we have more items than you need in total, the items I would prefer to pull back first would be the Telmax payment, the CRTC spectrum user fees, and the capitalization of specialized network overheads.








Please let us know how you wish to proceed.
</body>
